title: Shibby's Pinball Dungeon (ORIGINAL)
description: You find yourself at the entrance to a retro arcade “Player-1: Classic Video-Game Bar”. It's late but you’ve arrived perfectly on time for your first date with me, Shibby. What starts off as a pretty innocuous meeting quickly turns competitive as I challenge you to a game on my custom built pinball machine. We're both nerds so it won't take much to convince you to give it a shot. Win the high score and I'll go home with you; lose, and you belong to Me for the night. Sounds like a proposition you can't refuse, right? The game is devilishly hard mind you, deliberately rigged with spirals, traps, audio cues that exploit all your installed triggers and much more. Defeat was inevitable. After you lose, a secret trapdoor opens and you descend into my private dungeon. I don't waste any time cashing in my reward for your epic loss. I get to play with you. I lead you over to the corner of the dungeon where a perfect duplicate of the pinball machine resides, but this time it only serves to drag you deeper down into trance. You're utterly mine and you know it as I bend you over the machine, hearing a faint metalic whirring sound spinning behind you. Oh toy- do you know what I love to do with small metal balls? I like to put them in holes…
author: Mistress Shibby
